sql.if: and (menu_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or page_url like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or client_ip like '%' + #{keyword} + '%')

mapper.insert: insert into ${table} (user_id, login_name, user_name, dept_name, op_type, menu_id, menu_name, menu_path, page_url, client_ip, device, session_id, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime) values (#{e.userId}, #{e.loginName}, #{e.userName}, #{e.deptName}, #{e.opType}, #{e.menuId}, #{e.menuName}, #{e.menuPath}, #{e.pageUrl}, #{e.clientIp}, #{e.device}, #{e.sessionId}, #{e.modedatacreatedate}, #{e.modedatacreatetime})
mapper.select: select id, labelid, linkaddress, usecustomname, customname, routeurl, fullrouteurl, mobxrouteurl from LeftMenuInfo where (linkaddress is not null and linkaddress <> '') or (fullrouteurl is not null and fullrouteurl <> '') or (routeurl is not null and routeurl <> '') or (mobxrouteurl is not null and mobxrouteurl <> '')
select r.id as user_id, r.loginid as login_name, r.lastname as user_name, d.departmentname as dept_name from hrmresource r left join hrmdepartment d on d.id = r.departmentid where r.id = #{userId}
